scope: Independent source review of frozen V86 start-failure handling and placement, Lanț shortest-choice reserve, and two closed Contexto feedback pairs. No app/test edits and no tests run by this reviewer.
source_freeze_confirmation: Root forwarded UI author SOURCE FREEZE before final hashes were collected and rechecked.

resolved_findings.problem: A header-only error notice remained above the viewport after a failed replay at the bottom of a long result. Alert semantics did not make it visible to sighted players.
resolved_findings.resolution: GameShell banner removed. ResultCard renders the notice immediately before replay controls; Alchimie live Alt joc has its own adjacent notice. Both locations reserve the same responsive text/padding space before failure, preventing a new error from pushing the clicked retry button below a short viewport. Intro stays compact.
resolved_findings.verification: Final source inspected; strict notice and retry-button viewport assertions remain in the frozen browser test. Root relayed the author’s latest 16/16 focused rerun plus 10 unchanged initial-start cases passing in the preceding run.

acceptance_evidence.notice_accessibility: Reserved placeholder is visibility:hidden, aria-hidden and has no alert role or focusable controls. On failure it becomes the visible alert with unchanged responsive dimensions; generic Romanian text excludes technical error details.
acceptance_evidence.previous_round_and_scroll: Alchimie and Lanț separate creating from saved-resume loading and retain intro/round DOM during creation. Other four screens also retain prior state. Replacement-only feedback, record flags, history and local active-game pointer update only after successful create.
acceptance_evidence.promise_and_controls: All six creation paths guard synchronously against duplicate flights, clear the failure on a retry, catch failure without clearing prior round data and release pending state in finally. Pending intro controls are inert/disabled, completed replay controls are disabled, and exit/options handlers are guarded. Live Alchimie disables and synchronously guards gameplay mutations while a replacement is pending.
acceptance_evidence.lant_reserve: Up to two shortest on-corridor hops are selected before the remaining corridor quality slot. Existing three-corridor and six-total caps, reachable direct-edge filtering, visited-node exclusion, normalized-label deduplication and deterministic alphabetical public ordering remain. No route class, distance or node IDs are added to public choices.
acceptance_evidence.contexto_pairs: Only Ecler→Cremă de vanilie and Savarină→Frișcă join the exact-target pair set. Existing scorer checks source/target existence, preserves submitted public identity, prevents a proxied win and bypasses proxying for exact-self wins. No neighbor expansion or reverse graph edge is introduced; missing custom-graph targets fall back safely.
acceptance_evidence.consulted_tests: Read targeted tests for exact whole-graph feedback closure/custom targets, direct private Lanț menus and deterministic caps, plus first-start/replay/live replacement browser cases. Did not rerun them.

limits: Independent acceptance binds only the exact source hashes above; subsequent source changes require renewed review.
Focused browser counts are attributed to the UI author via root, not independently executed here.
The final complete frontend/browser matrix was still running when this review was archived; this is not a final integration or deployment approval.
